class.name: SubtitleSegment
class.brief_description: One timed text of a [Subtitle]: a time range, the text and what kind of text it is.
class.description: A [SubtitleSegment] is shown from [member start_time] until [member end_time]. [member text] holds the text without decoration: a sound is stored as [code]Applause[/code], and [SubtitleServer] shows it as [code][Applause][/code] (see [method SubtitleServer.get_display_text]). This keeps translations clean and lets players turn closed captions off separately from speech ([member SubtitleServer.captions_enabled]). Times are segment times in seconds ([code]1.5[/code] is 1500 ms). When a [Subtitle] is played, its [member Subtitle.time_offset] is added.

method.name: contains_time
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param time] is in the range [member start_time] (included) to [member end_time] (excluded). [param time] is a segment time, without [member Subtitle.time_offset].

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns [member end_time] minus [member start_time], at least [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: is_caption
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for closed captions rather than speech: [constant KIND_SOUND], [constant KIND_REACTION], [constant KIND_MUSIC] and [constant KIND_LYRICS].

members.member: The time in seconds at which the segment disappears.
What kind of text the segment holds. It decides the decoration in [method SubtitleServer.get_display_text] and whether the segment is a closed caption ([method is_caption]).
If [code]true[/code], the speaker is not visible, for example a voice on the phone. Usually shown in italics. SubRip files mark it with [code]<i>[/code] around the whole text.
Where the game should show the segment. [constant PLACEMENT_TOP] keeps text away from something important at the bottom of the screen. The engine stores the value; the game applies it.

Who speaks, for example to color the text or to show the name. SubRip files mark it with a leading name in capitals ([code]JOHN: Hello[/code]). If [member SubtitleServer.speakers] has a [DialogueSpeaker] with this id, its name and color are used ([method SubtitleServer.get_display_speaker], [SubtitleLabel]); the Inspector suggests these ids.
The time in seconds at which the segment appears.
The text, without decoration. It can have several lines. If [member Subtitle.auto_translate] is enabled, it is a translation key or a source text for [TranslationServer].
The context passed to [method TranslationServer.translate] when [member Subtitle.auto_translate] is enabled. Use it when the same text needs different translations.

constants.constant: A narrator. Shown in italics with BBCode.
A sound, for example [code]Applause[/code] or [code]Door creaks[/code]. Shown in brackets: [code][Applause][/code].
A sound a character makes, for example [code]laughs[/code] or [code]sighs[/code]. Shown in brackets.
A description of music, for example [code]calm music[/code]. Shown between music notes: [code]♪ calm music ♪[/code].
Words of a song. Shown between music notes, line by line.
Text that appears in the picture, for example a sign or a letter.
Represents the size of the [enum Kind] enum.
The game decides, usually at the bottom.
At the bottom of the screen.
At the top of the screen.
Represents the size of the [enum Placement] enum.
